example.title: Shingled fish shack on Bearskin Neck, Rockport

brief: A small grey-shingled fish shack with a gable front and a single window and door, flags and flower pots. One photo. Older than 1970: herring smokehouses, net sheds and fish houses on stilts in these harbours are 1880-1940 buildings; no newer examples. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Boatyard
